WORKFLOW & SCOPE SPECIFICATION

A centralized supervisory architecture designed for Tropical Gyros restaurant management approval. Introducing Admin account provisioning, custom permission assignments, and restaurant operational oversight while fully preserving the existing Next.js Admin Panel experience.

1. Two Separate Web Panels
Super Admin functions as the master supervisory portal; the existing Admin Panel remains completely preserved for daily kitchen and order processing.
2. Custom Permission Engine
Individually configure what each Admin can access and perform across Orders, Products, Categories, Payments, Staff, and Customers.
3. True Tropical Gyros Workflow
Built specifically for BSD currency, strict 3.0-mile delivery limits, Cash on Delivery (COD) tracking, and unique customer barcode verification.
4. Clear Implementation Roadmap
Transparently distinguishing existing frontend/localStorage prototype capabilities from proposed centralized backend integration features.

Tropical Gyros Super Admin Proposal Project Architecture & System Evolution
01 | Project Background
Architecture Overview

01. Project Background & 2-Panel Architecture

Contextualizing the actual Tropical Gyros restaurant applications and the introduction of centralized supervisory control.

The Existing Tropical Gyros Ecosystem (Current 3 Pillars)
Customer Mobile App
Flutter (iOS & Android)

Customer food ordering with category sliders (Meat Gyros, Bowls, Salads, Smoothies), dish customizations, strict 3.0-mile delivery limit, dynamic QR and card checkout, and unique order barcode generation.

Delivery & Cashier App
Flutter (iOS & Android)

Operational mobile terminal with dual-role login (Delivery Driver & Counter Cashier). Features camera barcode scanner for pickup/handover verification and Cash on Delivery (COD) collection tracking.

Existing Admin Panel
Next.js 16 + React 19 (Web)

Operational web console deployed live on Vercel. Operates as the central kitchen workspace for orders, status updates, products in BSD currency, categories, delivery staff roster, and customer records.

⚠️
CORE ARCHITECTURAL DIRECTIVE: TWO SEPARATE WEB PANELS (NO REPLACEMENT)
A. New Super Admin Panel: A dedicated new supervisory portal providing complete control over restaurant operations, Admin account creation, and granular permission assignments.
B. Existing Admin Panel: Must remain available as the existing Admin experience, preserving its current screens, UI, and day-to-day kitchen operations. Super Admin controls which modules each Admin can access.
Important: No separate "Orders-only" Admin Panel is introduced in this proposal.
Why the Super Admin Panel is Being Introduced
1. Dedicated Admin Account Provisioning
Currently, staff share local access. Super Admin will formally create, update, and activate/deactivate individual Admin accounts for kitchen supervisors, dispatchers, and cashiers.
2. Modular Custom Permission Control
Enables restaurant owners to individually toggle permissions (e.g. allowing front counter staff to print invoices while preventing them from editing food prices or deleting categories).
3. BSD Financial & Payment Oversight
Monitors all Cash on Delivery collections, un-remitted driver balances, card transactions, and total revenue calculated strictly in Bahamian Dollars (BSD).
4. Action Attribution & Accountability
Introduces operational activity logs to record which Admin performed specific actions (order status changes, price updates, driver assignments) with exact timestamps.
ℹ️
Implementation Transparency Note
The existing Admin Panel and Flutter apps currently operate with complete UI/UX implementations utilizing in-memory state and localStorage mock data. Centralized multi-admin authentication, dynamic permission enforcement, and live cross-panel synchronization represent PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE REQUIRING BACKEND INTEGRATION (e.g., Firebase, Supabase, or custom REST/WebSocket backend).

02 | Core Modules
Functional Scope

02. Super Admin Core Operational Modules

Direct supervisory capabilities covering restaurant orders, food menu catalog, categories, and payment ledgers.

01. Complete Dashboard & Analytics
Operational Overview

Provides management with a consolidated overview of restaurant operations, sales velocity, and order pipeline health.

  • Overall Restaurant Performance: Monitor active operations across kitchen and dispatch.
  • Daily Sales Summary: Total revenue calculated strictly in Bahamian Dollars (BSD).
  • Total Orders Funnel: Track orders across Pending, Preparing, Dispatched, Delivered, Completed.
  • Payment Breakdown: Distribution of Cash on Delivery (COD) vs Card vs QR vs Apple Pay.
  • Pending & Active Orders: Immediate count of orders awaiting kitchen acceptance.
  • Operational Analytics: Overview of order completion volume and delivery fulfillment.
02. Orders Management
Full Control

Super Admin maintains full access and override authority across all customer orders placed in the ecosystem.

  • View All Orders: Unrestricted access to active, delivered, and cancelled orders.
  • Order Details & Customizations: View items, special notes, spiciness, and delivery address.
  • Order Status Progression: Update status (Pending → Preparing → Dispatched → Delivered).
  • Assign Delivery Staff: Select and assign available couriers to delivery orders.
  • Order Barcode Tracking: Inspect unique barcode strings (e.g. TRP-884920-BC).
  • Order Operations: Cancel orders with reason, print customer receipts and kitchen tickets.
03. Products Management

Master control over the Tropical Gyros food menu, prices, and stock.

  • Add, Edit & Delete Dishes: Manage menu items, descriptions, and photos.
  • BSD Pricing Control: Update food prices strictly in Bahamian Dollars (BSD).
  • Stock Availability: Toggle items "In Stock" or "Sold Out" instantly.
  • Dish Customization: Configure spiciness levels and ingredients list.
04. Categories Management

Manage menu categories with built-in duplicate prevention integrity.

  • Add, Edit & Delete Categories: Organize Gyros, Bowls, Salads, Smoothies.
  • Duplicate Prevention Engine: Case-insensitive & trimmed space check blocks duplicates (e.g. "meat gyros" vs "Meat Gyros").
  • Category Display Order: Manage display sequence on customer app.
  • Category Active Switch: Temporarily hide or activate menu sections.
05. Payments & COD Management
Financial Oversight

Comprehensive visibility over payment statuses, methods, and Cash on Delivery collections.

  • Payment Information: Monitor transaction statuses (Paid, Pending, Failed).
  • Payment Methods: Review breakdown across COD, Card, Apple Pay, QR.
  • COD Collection Records: Track cash collected by couriers in the field.
  • Mark Cash Received: Verify and record cash remitted at the restaurant counter.

03 | Staff & Access
Personnel Governance

03. Delivery Staff, Customer & Admin Management

Managing restaurant delivery drivers, registered customer accounts, and provisioning Admin access.

06. Delivery Staff Management
Driver Operations

Manage delivery staff operating the Tropical Gyros Delivery & Cashier mobile app.

  • Add & Edit Delivery Staff: Maintain driver name, phone number, and email.
  • Vehicle Records: Record vehicle type (Scooter, Bike, Car) and vehicle plate number.
  • Account Status Toggles: Activate or deactivate driver accounts for shift control.
  • Availability Status: Monitor driver status (Available, On Delivery, Offline).
  • Delivery Assignments: View active orders currently assigned to each driver.
  • Delivery Activity: Track total completed deliveries and COD cash collection status.
07. Customer Management
Customer Records

Access and manage customer records registered through the Customer mobile application.

  • View Customer Records: Searchable list of customer names, emails, and phone numbers.
  • Customer Details & Addresses: Inspect saved delivery addresses within the 3-mile perimeter.
  • Customer Order History: Complete chronological log of customer orders and totals in BSD.
  • Manage Customer Accounts: Toggle customer status between active and banned.
08. Admin Management & Access Governance
Central Authority

Super Admin creates and governs Admin accounts for staff members who operate the existing Admin Panel.

Admin Account Controls
  • Create Admin Accounts: Provision new accounts for kitchen leads, counter cashiers, and dispatchers.
  • View Admin Accounts: Review staff list, phone, email, assigned role, and status.
  • Edit Admin Information: Update name, contact details, or assigned operational duties.
  • Activate / Deactivate Accounts: Instant toggle to suspend Admin login access.
Relationship to Existing Admin Panel
  • Existing Panel Preservation: The existing Admin Panel remains available for daily use.
  • Permission Enforcement: Super Admin controls access to each screen via custom permissions.
  • Review Assigned Permissions: Immediate view of active rights granted to each Admin.
  • No Self-Elevation: Admins cannot grant themselves permissions or alter other accounts.
🔒
Security Principle: Regular Admins log into the existing Admin Panel and can only see or interact with features authorized by the Super Admin. Only the Super Admin possesses access to the Admin Management and Permission Engine.

04 | Custom Permissions
Access Governance

04. Custom Roles & Granular Permissions

Super Admin decides exactly what each Admin can access and perform in the existing Admin Panel.

Granular Permission Architecture (Module 09)

Instead of rigid, hard-coded roles, the Super Admin Panel introduces modular capability toggles. Management can individually enable, modify, or revoke specific operational permissions per Admin account matching their exact shift responsibilities.

1. ORDERS PERMISSIONS
• View Orders
• View Order Details
• Update Order Status
• Assign Delivery Staff
• Cancel Orders
• Print Invoice
• Export Orders
2. PRODUCTS PERMISSIONS
• View Products
• Add Products
• Edit Products
• Delete Products
• Update Stock Availability
3. CATEGORIES PERMISSIONS
• View Categories
• Add Categories
• Edit Categories
• Delete Categories
4. PAYMENTS PERMISSIONS
• View Payments
• View Transactions
• Mark Cash Received
5. DELIVERY STAFF PERMISSIONS
• View Staff
• Add Staff
• Edit Staff
• Manage Assignments
6. CUSTOMERS PERMISSIONS
• View Customers
• View Customer Details
• Manage Customer Accounts
Custom Admin Permission Example (Illustrative Configuration)
* Illustrative example only; not a final permission configuration
Permission Admin A Admin B Admin C
View Orders YES YES YES
Update Status NO YES YES
Assign Driver NO NO YES
Cancel Orders NO NO NO
Print Invoice YES YES YES
View Payments NO NO YES
Dynamic Control: Permissions are individually controlled by the Super Admin according to each Admin's operational responsibilities. Super Admin can modify or revoke permissions whenever required.
